criteria.name: Object-Oriented Design
criteria.description: Proper use of classes, encapsulation, and access modifiers. Should have private data members and public methods.

criteria.name: Core Functionality
criteria.description: Correctly implements deposit, withdrawal, and balance display. Account should maintain owner name and balance.

criteria.name: Error Handling and Validation
criteria.description: Validates inputs (no negative deposits/withdrawals), prevents overdrafts, handles edge cases properly.

criteria.name: Code Quality
criteria.description: Clean code structure, meaningful variable names, proper documentation, and comments. Multi-file organization for compiled languages.
